A map of lists of entries. entries holds a str key, a key written after its value with a list under the value, an int key with no value and a member the verb does not read, and a bool key with a null value. repeats holds the key a twice. keyless holds an element with no key, not_maps an element that is an int, null_key an element whose key is a null, and none is empty. The calls show that the members keep the order of the elements, that a key met again keeps its first place and takes the last value, that a missing value is a null, what the empty list answers, which elements are refused, and that entries followed by from_entries gives the map back.
